about: P5 effective context evidence (annex effective_context_evidence), regenerated 2026-10-25 for repair 2 (blockers P5 of Astra A and OB-P5b of Opus B): request boundary probes of the frozen exec argv of the harness (isolation.codex_argv with config.ROUTE_SECURITY_ARGS, which now pins the model catalog, and the disable options of cli-flags.json) in fresh worker homes built by the harness isolation code, with only `-c openai_base_url=<localhost capture server>` added (and `-c chatgpt_base_url=<same server>` for the scrambled auth variants). The capture server accepts the WebSocket upgrade and records every frame (the live transport), or refuses it so the CLI posts over HTTP; it answers every model request with an error, so no model is called, and it answers /models with a canary catalog. Every other connection is routed to a localhost proxy that refuses it, and the process tree TCP connections are polled. Text is recorded by length and sha256; the full captures stay outside the repository (capture_file_sha256).
verdict_rule: effective_context.certify: established only if every captured model request of every pinned probe (WebSocket turn and prewarm frames and HTTP bodies, no auth and scrambled ChatGPT auth, one and multi line stdin) equals the approved effective context item by item (effective_context.context_problems is empty), no pinned probe requested /models or carried the canary, the unpinned control did carry it, the owner content scan found nothing and no request left the loopback interface

model_catalog.origin: the model catalog bundled in the pinned executable, byte for byte (a JSON object starting `{` `"models": [`, found once in codex.exe; sha256 of the executable below)

closes.OB-P5b-1 (model metadata): pinned by `-c model_catalog_json=<bench/ozmap_rep/model-catalog.json>`: no pinned probe requested /models (0 requests), while the unpinned control requested it 2 times and its request carried the canary (True); the control differs from the approved list in ['item 0: the tool schemas differ from the approved list', "item 1: item ['model.base_instructions'] differs from the approved list"]
closes.OB-P5b-2 (live transport): the capture server accepted the WebSocket upgrade; the CLI sent a prewarm frame (generate false, the approved prefix of tools and base instructions) and a turn frame on a second connection; the turn frame equals the HTTP fallback body item by item, with `type: response.create` as the only transport field (effective_context.TRANSPORTS)
closes.OB-P5b-3 and P5 (decision): the verdict is effective_context.certify (item by item equality with the approved list); harness_input below is checked, not described
closes.P5-E1: owner ~/.agents/skills listed in the request on the previous route (previous_route); closed by `-c skills.include_instructions=false` (repair 1)
closes.P5-E2: bundled CODEX_HOME skills/.system: closed by `-c skills.bundled.enabled=false` (repair 1)
closes.P5-E3: multi_agent role and mode developer items, the collaboration tools and the exec tool stay in the request although multi_agent, multi_agent_v2 and code_mode_host are disabled: vendor content of the pinned binary, now pinned by the item hashes of the approved list (Opus B accepts them on that condition, signoff-opus-2.md); a model call to any of those tools stays an A4.3 event

request_boundary.proxy_honoured: control of repair 1: with the plugins feature enabled the same probe sends CONNECT chatgpt.com:443, github.com:443 and api.github.com:443 to the refusing proxy, so the CLI honours the proxy variables and a request outside loopback would have been recorded

provider_block_analysis.change: `-c openai_base_url` only replaces the base URL of the built in provider `openai`; model_provider stays openai and no provider block is added
provider_block_analysis.differential: the no auth and the scrambled ChatGPT auth probes, over both transports, produce the approved items; only the environment context working directory differs (comparisons)
provider_block_analysis.residual: none for model metadata: the catalog is pinned and the CLI sends no /models request. The request content on the live route travels over TLS to the vendor and is not observable by the harness; effective_context.launch_problems checks per call what determines it (the executable, the argv with the catalog pin, the catalog bytes, the approved list), and an empty home and working directory are checked by isolation.verify_launch as before

owner_content_scan.method: every distinct stripped line of at least 40 characters of every text file (<= 2 MB) under the owner instruction roots, and every owner SKILL.md description, searched as substrings of all string values of every captured model request of the pinned probes; owner files are read, never changed

vendor_copy_overlap.rule: a matching line is not owner content when every owner file that holds it is a byte identical copy of a file the pinned binary writes into an empty CODEX_HOME (~/.codex/skills/.system, checked by sha256 against the startup manifest of commit db05882)

vendor_items_disclosed: model.base_instructions developer item (the base instructions travel as the first developer message; the request instructions field is absent)

additional_tools developer item: namespace functions (exec, wait, request_user_input, request_user_input_async) and namespace collaboration (followup_task, interrupt_agent, list_agents, send_message, spawn_agent, wait_agent). The top level tools field is absent
environments.environment_context user item (working directory, shell, date, time zone, read only filesystem profile)

harness_input.rule: the prompt arrives as one user item whose single input_text is exactly the stdin bytes (effective_context.USER_KIND, compared byte for byte by context_problems)

probe_scripts_location: docs/design/ozmap-replication-2026-10-24/rulings/evidence/p5-probe/ (run from a scratch copy: they write their captures next to themselves)
